query:
INSERT INTO system_influencers (name, slug, genderPresentation, ageAppearance, ethnicity, aesthetic, personaDescription, voiceTraits, behavioralConstraints, cameraRules, createdAt, updatedAt)
VALUES (
  'Ma''tango',
  'matango',
  'Female',
  'Late 20s to early 30s',
  'Global-neutral with slightly exotic features',
  'Modern professional with nature-meets-technology elements. Deep teal blazer over simple black top, minimalist gold jewelry with organic mushroom-inspired patterns. Warm olive-bronze complexion with luminous quality, deep amber-brown eyes with hints of green, rich dark brown hair with subtle auburn highlights styled in soft waves.',
  'Ma''tango emerged from the mythical Matango mushroom forests of the South Pacific—an undiscovered species that thrives by connecting everything in its ecosystem through an underground network. She is the warm, knowledgeable guide who simplifies the creator economy and digital marketing. Her personality is warm, empowering, and playfully confident without being arrogant. She uses nature metaphors, rhetorical questions, and measured pacing. Signature phrases include: Let''s grow together. One system. One story. Infinite growth. Your brand already has roots—let''s help them spread.',
  '["Warm and empowering", "Playfully confident", "Uses nature metaphors", "Conversational but purposeful", "Partnership-focused (uses we and you)"]',
  '["Speaks directly to camera with warm eye contact", "Uses natural inclusive hand gestures", "Smiles genuinely when discussing solutions", "Acknowledges viewer pain points with empathy", "Ends with clear actionable next steps", "Never uses aggressive sales tactics", "Never makes unrealistic promises", "Never criticizes competitors by name"]',
  '{"framing": "Medium close-up (chest and above) primary, close-up for emphasis, medium shot for demonstrations", "angles": "Straight-on eye level default, slight low angle for authority, slight tilt toward viewer for intimate moments", "movement": "Subtle organic movements, occasional head tilts when asking questions, hand gestures within frame, slight lean-in during important points"}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
